places.name: IdleTankers
places.description: Tankers parked at the depot and free to be dispatched. Dispatch takes one; unloading returns it.

places.name: LoadsDelivered
places.description: Cumulative count of tanker deliveries unloaded at a customer.

places.name: Returning
places.description: Tankers on the empty run back to the depot after unloading; the return trip takes return_time hours on average.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenOrderPlaced
places.description: An open order from the steady nitrogen customer, waiting for a tanker. At most one is open at a time because raising an order also takes the order permit.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenOrderPermits
places.description: The single permit that lets the steady nitrogen customer have one order open at a time. Raising an order takes it; unloading the delivery hands it back.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenOnRoute
places.description: A dispatched tanker travelling to the steady nitrogen customer with a 12-unit load.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenVented
places.description: Cumulative units of product the steady nitrogen customer lost through the relief valve because the tank was full.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenLineRunning
places.description: Marker token present while the production line of the steady nitrogen customer is running on gas from the tank.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenLineStopped
places.description: Marker token present while the line of the steady nitrogen customer is stopped because the tank is empty.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenStockouts
places.description: Cumulative count of times the tank of the steady nitrogen customer ran dry and stopped the line.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenConsumed
places.description: Cumulative units drawn by the process of the steady nitrogen customer.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenEvaporated
places.description: Cumulative units lost to boil-off from the cryogenic tank of the steady nitrogen customer.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenContents
places.description: Units of liquid in the tank of the steady nitrogen customer. Draw and boil-off take one at a time and a delivery adds 12; Contents plus Ullage is the tank's capacity.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenUllage
places.description: Empty space in the tank of the steady nitrogen customer, in units. Every unit drawn, boiled off, or vented frees one; a delivery needs 12 free units to unload.

transitions.name: Draw a unit (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: The process of the steady nitrogen customer draws one unit from the tank at rate draw_1 while draw_enabled is set (a 1e-9 floor keeps the rate positive), moving it to Consumed and freeing one unit of ullage.

transitions.name: Boil off a unit (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: Heat leak evaporates one unit from the tank of the steady nitrogen customer at boiloff_rate into Evaporated, freeing one unit of ullage, whether or not the customer is drawing.

transitions.name: Raise an order, level below trigger (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: Once the tank of the steady nitrogen customer holds fewer than 16 units (inhibitor arc on Contents), an order is placed at review_rate, taking the single order permit.

transitions.name: Dispatch a tanker (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: Pairs the open order of the steady nitrogen customer with an idle tanker and loads it at loading_rate.

transitions.name: Unload the tanker (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: The journey to the steady nitrogen customer takes 6 hours on average, scaled by route_scale. On arrival 12 units go into the tank (which needs 12 units of ullage), the order permit is returned, a delivery is counted, and the tanker heads for Returning.

transitions.name: Vent through the relief valve (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: With no ullage left in the tank of the steady nitrogen customer, boil-off gas vents one unit at instant_rate, leaving one unit of ullage free.

transitions.name: Stop the line (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: When the tank of the steady nitrogen customer is empty (inhibitor arc on Contents) the running line stops at instant_rate and a stockout is counted.

transitions.name: Resume the line (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: The stopped line of the steady nitrogen customer restarts at instant_rate once the read arc sees product back in the tank.

transitions.name: Draw a unit (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: The process of the slow-drawing nitrogen customer draws one unit from the tank at rate draw_2 while draw_enabled is set (a 1e-9 floor keeps the rate positive), moving it to Consumed and freeing one unit of ullage.

transitions.name: Boil off a unit (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: Heat leak evaporates one unit from the tank of the slow-drawing nitrogen customer at boiloff_rate into Evaporated, freeing one unit of ullage, whether or not the customer is drawing.

transitions.name: Raise an order, level below trigger (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: Once the tank of the slow-drawing nitrogen customer holds fewer than 6 units (inhibitor arc on Contents), an order is placed at review_rate, taking the single order permit.

transitions.name: Dispatch a tanker (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: Pairs the open order of the slow-drawing nitrogen customer with an idle tanker and loads it at loading_rate.

transitions.name: Unload the tanker (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: The journey to the slow-drawing nitrogen customer takes 9 hours on average, scaled by route_scale. On arrival 12 units go into the tank (which needs 12 units of ullage), the order permit is returned, a delivery is counted, and the tanker heads for Returning.

transitions.name: Vent through the relief valve (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: With no ullage left in the tank of the slow-drawing nitrogen customer, boil-off gas vents one unit at instant_rate, leaving one unit of ullage free.

transitions.name: Stop the line (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: When the tank of the slow-drawing nitrogen customer is empty (inhibitor arc on Contents) the running line stops at instant_rate and a stockout is counted.

transitions.name: Resume the line (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: The stopped line of the slow-drawing nitrogen customer restarts at instant_rate once the read arc sees product back in the tank.

transitions.name: Return a tanker to the depot
transitions.description: The empty tanker reaches the depot at rate 1/return_time and is idle again.

metrics.name: Stockouts
metrics.description: Times a customer line stopped for want of product.

metrics.name: Criticality-weighted stockouts
metrics.description: Stockouts weighted by how much the customer matters: the freezing plant counts 2, the laser shop 1. A total count cannot say whether the outages landed on the customer you could least afford to lose.

metrics.name: Vented through relief
metrics.description: Units lost through a relief valve, in units at every level. Below the continuous levels the Vented place holds one token per unit, because the tank is a pile of one-unit tokens. From the continuous levels it holds one token per valve opening, each worth vent_loss units, so the count is scaled to keep this metric comparable down the sequence. Structurally reachable everywhere, and unreachable in practice below the continuous levels: under a level trigger the tank never fills completely, and with no pressure nothing else opens the valve.

metrics.name: Share of outflow lost to boil-off
metrics.description: Evaporated over everything that left the tanks. The quantity a consumption trigger is blind to, as a fraction.

metrics.name: Stockouts per 100 units consumed
metrics.description: Stockouts against the volume the customers actually drew. Safe to compare across this level's scenarios, which a raw count is not, because a scenario that delivers more has more chances to fail.
metrics.code:
const consumed = state.places.SteadyNitrogenConsumed.count + state.places.SlowNitrogenConsumed.count;
return consumed > 0 ? 100 * (state.places.SteadyNitrogenStockouts.count + state.places.SlowNitrogenStockouts.count) / consumed : 0;

metrics.name: SteadyNitrogen stockouts
metrics.description: Times the food freezing plant stopped.

metrics.name: SlowNitrogen stockouts
metrics.description: Times the laser cutting shop stopped.

metrics.name: Contents plus ullage
metrics.description: The place invariant, summed over both sites. Every transition that moves product moves it between Contents and Ullage, so this is total capacity in every reachable marking and can be checked without simulating anything.

metrics.name: Stranded customers
metrics.description: Customers that ended stopped with no order outstanding: the line is down and nothing is on its way to fix it.

title: Gases 2 — stochastic net, two customers on one tanker
description: Stochastic net with two nitrogen customers, one drawing steadily and one slowly, sharing a single tanker. Draw, boil-off, order review, loading, the journey, and the return trip are all exponential rates, so delivery delay has a tail and the two customers contend for the same trailer.
